notes: Dimensions use the SAAMI 12 Gauge 2¾-inch Smooth Bore cartridge/chamber drawing (printed p. 20, PDF p. 21), not the separate rifled-barrel drawing.

Federal identifies PFC154 00 as a 12-gauge 2¾-inch load with nine lead 00-Buck pellets, but does not identify the crimp style. SAAMI gives both folded and rolled closed lengths. `length.loaded` uses the longer rolled length as a conservative action-clearance envelope; `closure` remains unknown rather than assuming the product's crimp.
